text:
pranav: Noticed dozens of training pods falling into NCCL_TRANSPORT fallback after this morning's EFA/OFED + kernel security patch rollout in eu-west-2. Jobs move from ib to tcp mid-run, huge latency jitter.
liz: Which package versions rolled? logs?
infra-bot: Rollout record: rollout_id rf-roll-20260318-07 on hosts gpu-eu2-[a1..a10]. Kernel bumped 5.15.124 -> 5.15.140. OFED: 5.6.0-1.1. EFA firmware: efa_fw_v2.3.0. See /var/log/rollouts/rf-roll-20260318-07.log
sam: Reproduced on a 2-node repro: nccl-tests all_reduce shows intermittent fallback: "NCCL WARN Call to ibv_create_cq failed" then network switches to tcp, allreduce time spikes.
derek: Captured packet traces, see /tmp/efa-pcap-eu2.pcap. Observed high number of RNR NAKs and delayed ACKs during key phases. Suggests new CC profile+firmware interaction.
pranav: Quick mitigation: can we pin nodes to old firmware/driver? If rollback not possible, suggested env toggles: `export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` or `export NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=1` seems to reduce failures, but throughput suffers.
priscilla: Tried setting `MLX5_TUNE_PSZ=0` on one host via sysfs and it improved steady-state bandwidth but didn't stop occasional fallback.
oncall: Scheduling emergency rollback window 2026-03-18 23:30 UTC; contact oncall if needed earlier.
liz: Can we try driver param to force prefer_hca=safe or set mlx5 kernel param `mlx5_core.use_rqpn=1`? also need perf counters from svl nodes.
sam: Quick test: `echo 0 > /sys/module/mlx5_core/parameters/enable_event_mask` (do not run broadly) increased stability on test host. Not safe cluster-wide.
derek: Opening INFRA-7412 with traces + perf counters. Assign to net/infra team. For now, avoid scheduling long GPU jobs in gpu-eu2 pools. :warning:
pranav: Acknowledged. I'm updating our autoscaler to throttle new provisioning in eu-west-2 and redirect to eu-west-1 until rollback or fix.
priscilla: Note: this affects mixed-kernel nodes only; older kernels untouched. We'll gather exact host list and create a rollback plan.
infra-bot: Rollback candidate available: fw_snapshot_20260317_23 for hosts gpu-eu2-[a1..a10]. Can be applied via /ops/rollbacks/run rf-roll-rollback-20260318.
pranav: Thanks. I'll coordinate rollback if net confirms risk. Meanwhile putting a label on affected ASGs to prevent autoscale up.
